title: Gluing the affine embedded-point submodules
statement: Let $X$ be a locally Noetherian scheme [pqf-def-locnoeth] and $\mathcal F$ a coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module [pqf-def-coherent]. Suppose that on an affine open cover each module of sections has a finite submodule whose localization on every smaller affine open is the corresponding chosen submodule. Then these compatible submodules define a coherent subsheaf $\mathcal K\subseteq\mathcal F$, and the affine quotients glue to the quotient sheaf $\mathcal F/\mathcal K$.
